name: mobile-nav-drilldown
title: Drill-down mobile menu
description: A phone menu where each group slides its links in as a new panel with a Back row, the way native apps navigate.
docs: Pass brand, the groups and, if you like, actions (sign in, start free) and current, the href of the page you are on. A group with links opens as a panel of its own; a group without links is a plain link, and one with links and an href offers an All row first that leads to the group's own page. Every link closes the sheet. Escape goes up a level before it closes the sheet, Up, Down, Home and End move between the rows, and the panels you cannot see are inert, so their links are never tabbable. DrilldownMenu is the same menu without the sheet, for a container of your own, and defaultGroup opens one panel first. The menu button is shown at every width: pass className="md:hidden" to hide it from md up, or trigger to use a button of your own. open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the sheet, labels translates the fixed words, and linkAs renders your router's Link. onOpenChange is a function, so use the menu from a Client Component if you control it.
